methodNotes.pixel-comparison: A reference region and an actual region are captured and compared at zero tolerance. referenceReady, actualReady and comparisonCompleted all apply.
methodNotes.behaviour: referenceReady is always false and that is not a gap: a behaviour-verified key never loads a reference page. spec.md (Session 2026-08-14) records that no picture of the binding status row can pair with production on absolute bounds, so these keys are proven by assertions on data-status-state, the title bar, the status-item text and the binding colour token instead.
